Prior to the first Integration run using Harmony, I got an error that indicated that there was an incorrect matrix columns. I sifter through my data tables to make sure that at least all of sample titles were filled. Turns out one was not it was supposed to be.

Somehow the sample HP0(GSM5494346) was transformed into Healthy-PC1 identity and condition column along with all other clinical variables it should have (Age) is gone. Not only that but this change is only isolated to HP0. All other samples are unaffected.

# Finally Integration Time

**Run Normalization**

**Run Variable Features**

Ranks Features by number of dataset they are deemed variable. Because the variance of a genes scales non-linearly with the mean expression of each gene, methods will need to isolate heterogeneity using a normalized or standardized metric. Asking: How much more variable a gene is than expected given it's mean expression

Ways to rank features:

1.  Dispersion-Based

Dispersion_i = variance_i / mean_i

2.  Variance Stabilization method (local polynomial Regression)
3.  Pearson Residual Variance

**Select Integration Features:** Ranks features by the number of datasets they are deemed variable. Breaking ties by the median variable features rank across datasets.

### Integration Prep

```{r}
library(harmony)
```

```{r}
PCa_list <- list(gse181294.obj, gse150692.obj, gse176031.obj, gse141445.obj)
names(PCa_list) <- c("GSE181294", "GSE150692", "GSE176031", "GSE141445")

#clear individual Seurat objects from active RAM
rm(gse181294.obj, 
   gse150692.obj, 
   gse176031.obj, 
   gse141445.obj)

#merge the list of Seurat Object
PCa_merge <- merge(
  x = PCa_list[[1]],
  y = PCa_list[-1],
  add.cell.ids = names(PCa_list),
  project = "merge_object"
)

#THis part is necessary for CCA integration

#First
PCa_merge  <- NormalizeData(PCa_merge , verbose = FALSE)
PCa_merge <- FindVariableFeatures(PCa_merge, nfeatures = 10000, verbose = FALSE)
PCa_merge <- ScaleData(PCa_merge, verbose = FALSE)
PCa_merge <- RunPCA(PCa_merge, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)



#Memory Load: PCa_object memory load: 5.1 GB
```

### CCA (Seuratv5)

```{r}
PCa_merge <- readRDS("./merged_objects/PCa_merged.rds")
```

```{r}
#CCA requires that the layers are seperated with HVGs and ScaleData input
PCa_object_int <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = PCa_merge,
  method = CCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  new.reduction = "integrated.cca",
  dims = 1:30,
  verbose = FALSE)


PCa_object_int <- JoinLayers(PCa_object_int)


PCa_object_int <- FindNeighbors(PCa_object_int, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)

resolutions <- c(0.6, 0.8, 1)
for(res in resolutions){
  PCa_object_int <- FindClusters(PCa_object_int, 
                                 resolution = res,
                                 verbose = FALSE)
}

PCa_object_int <- RunUMAP(PCa_object_int, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = FALSE)


DimPlot(PCa_object_int, reduction = "umap" ,group.by  = "orig.ident", raster = TRUE)

DimPlot(PCa_object_int, reduction = "umap" ,group.by  = "condition", raster = TRUE)

saveRDS(PCa_object_int, "./merged_sc_objects/seurat_cca_int_attempt2.rds")
```

# Measuring the Quality of Sample Mixing

Mixing Score

```{r}
harmony_attempt1 <- readRDS("./merged_sc_objects/harmony_int.rds")
```

```{r}
cca_attempt1 <- readRDS("./merged_sc_objects/seurat_cca_int_attempt2.rds")
```

```{r}
calc_mixing_metric <- function(object, 
                               group_id = "geo_acc", 
                               reduction = "umap", 
                               k = 50){
  #Pull cell embeddings
  embedding <- Seurat::Embeddings(object, reduction  = reduction)
  
  #KNN Test
  nn_result <- FNN::get.knn(embedding[, 1:2], k = k)
  
  #Calculate diversity of samples within the neighboorhood
  group_labels <- object@meta.da[[group_by]]
  mixing_scores <- sapply(1:nrow(nn_result$nn.index), function(i){
    neighbors <- nn_result$nn.index[i, ]
    neighbor_groups <- group_labels[neighbors]
    props <- table(neighbor_groups) / length(neighbor_groups)
    #Inverse Simpson's Index
    1 / sum(props^2)
  })
  return(mean(mixing_scores))
}
```

```{r}
args_list <- list(
  "Harmony" = list(object = harmony_attempt1, reduction = "umap.harmony", k = 20),
  "CCA" = list(object = cca_attempt1, reduction = "umap")
)

mixing_results <- data.frame(
  method = names(args_list),
  
  mixing_score = sapply(args_list, function(x){
    calc_mixing_metric(x$object, group_by = "geo_acc", reduction = x$reduction, k = x$k)
  }),
  
  n_clusters_0.6 = sapply(args_list, function(x){
    length(unique(x$object$RNA_snn_res.0.6))
    }),
  
  n_clusters_0.8 = sapply(args_list, function(x){
    length(unique(x$object$RNA_snn_res.0.8))
  }),
  
  n_clusters_1.0 = sapply(args_list, function(x){
    length(unique(x$object$RNA_snn_res.1))
  })
  
)
mixing_results
```

```{r}
p_mixing <- ggplot(mixing_results, aes(x = reorder(method, -mixing_score), y = mixing_score, fill = method)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mixing_score, 2)), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Integration Method Comparison: Sample Mixing",
       subtitle = "Higher score = better integration (samples mix within cell types)",
       x = "Integration Method",
       y = "Mixing Score (Local Inverse Simpson's Index)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```
